Perfect! The fix is working. The issue was floating-point precision: when converting 39.95 to cents by multiplying by 100, you get `3995.0000000000005` instead of `3995`. I've added `Math.round()` to both `parseEuros()` and `cellCents()` functions in `src/money.js` to eliminate this rounding error.

The tests all pass, and I've verified that prices like 39.95, 12.99, and 10.99 all work correctly now. Would you like me to commit this fix?
